premises.text: Investment advisors struggle to provide personalized portfolios due to outdated technology and processes
premises.evidence_span: Clients expect personalized portfolios tailored to their needs, but instead are getting dumped into generic buckets of mutual funds and ETFs.

premises.text: Vise AI can automate portfolio construction and management for investment advisors
premises.evidence_span: Vise AI is an artificial intelligence platform tailored to investment advisors so they can automate portfolio construction and management.

premises.text: Vise AI builds personalized portfolios based on clients' values, goals, and dreams
premises.evidence_span: Vise AI empowers advisors to be able to build personalized portfolios around their clients' values, goals, and dreams.

premises.text: The platform provides portfolio intelligence to help advisors explain investment decisions to clients
premises.evidence_span: we then provide the portfolio intelligence for them to be able to explain those investment decisions and the why behind their portfolio to the clients.

premises.text: Vise AI allows seamless transition of existing portfolios into its system
premises.evidence_span: advisors can seamlessly transition existing portfolios from their custodians into Vise AI.

premises.text: The platform customizes investment strategies based on client-specific criteria
premises.evidence_span: we take a goal-based approach to investing, looking at the client's goals, risk criteria, behavioral details, and others.

premises.text: Vise AI provides transparency in portfolio management compared to traditional models
premises.evidence_span: we lift the hood off the portfolio, showing the advisor exactly what they're investing in and why they're investing in it.

premises.text: Vise AI uses advanced quant models and machine learning for portfolio personalization
premises.evidence_span: we couple advanced quant models with machine learning models to build a personalized portfolio to each client.

premises.text: The platform has a distribution advantage through partnerships with major financial institutions
premises.evidence_span: We have partnered with Fortune 100 financial institutions and a successful trailblazer in space, Riskalyze, to give us a distribution advantage to over 25,000 advisors.

value.text: Investment advisors can provide personalized and transparent portfolio management to their clients
value.evidence_span: making them look smarter and providing a better result.

notes: Traction details and team backgrounds excluded as they do not constitute premises.
